Complete [[Jokanur Diggings]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Take [[Melonni]] to investigate the deaths of workers at the [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost)|Jokanur Diggings]] in the ruins of [[Fahranur, the First City]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission with two [[Sunspear Ghost]]s left alive.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Jokanur Diggings#Walkthrough|Jokanur Diggings]] mission.
